items.quote: I had a great experience with Paradise! They listened to what I wanted and delivered in a timely manner. Huge difference in my backyard appearance. I like that they will make suggestions and answer all my questions. Reasonably priced, excellent service and hard working. I highly recommend Paradise Landscaping!
I had an outstanding experience with Paradise Irrigation and Landscape in Tampa. Prince runs a top notch operation: professional, responsive, and genuinely focused on customer satisfaction.

Definitely use this company! We needed irrigation in quickly and Prince and his team delivered. After the system was in, it looked like it never even happened, they did such a great job replacing the grass and cleaning up. I will always use them in the future.
